ruledOut: Re-deriving the plan's per-transport inbound acknowledge sequence: the 002 design already fixes the seven steps and dedupe keys
Treating Slack's do-not-ack-if-not-retained rule as new: the plan already cites it
Searching for a reference-side durable seen store: none exists

label: The plan names no retention horizon for seen/, and the reference's only sizing datum is a 4096-entry in-memory update window with head eviction plus a process-local offset that resets to zero, so its dedupe is non-durable and its eviction is safe only within one process

A chunked Telegram send reports which chunks landed through sent_before_error and continuation_message_ids, while the plan's one-entry-one-state queue has no chunk continuation record, so a failed multi-chunk prompt would duplicate the chunks that already arrived

Slack separates definite non-delivery (HTTP 200 with ok:false, nothing applied) from an unreadable response (HTTP 200 with a non-JSON body), and the plan carries no such split for Slack though it applies the same distinction to WhatsApp

Slack refuses an over-long or disabled button before dispatch: label capped at 75 characters, action id at 255 bytes, the id copied into value, while the plan's button rule checks only the secret literal and states no length cap
